expectations.buyer: Refrigerant reclaimers, equipment operators, distributors, auditors, and regulators enforcing reclaimed-gas rules
expectations.pain: Virgin fluorinated gas can be mislabeled as reclaimed, while purity, origin, mass balance, and quota treatment cross several custody and test points
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Reclaimer certificates, laboratory purity testing, cylinder tracking, customs/quota systems, chain-of-custody documents, and F-gas enforcement
expectations.biggestRisk: Accredited lab testing and regulator documentation may own the truth; mass balance alone cannot prove physical identity or detect blended gas
